alternatives.argument: The complete local helper lem-dense-cube-polynomial-norming-and-reproduction proves interior Bernstein from finite Fejer sums, central extrapolation, polynomial damping and finite convex separation, with exp(Cn) coefficient variation at n*h bounded. Weighted Gaussian feature coordinates reproduce through degree n; the factorial tail gives the full C exp(-c |log h|/h) power bound. This argument uses no unproved Madych/Wendland or Fourier native-space extension theorem.

The existing complete orthogonal-projection inequality and iid fill-distance event combine with the newly fully proved Gaussian power-function supplier. They retain the original simultaneous bound for every Gaussian-RKHS interpolant with probability at least1-1/n.

A complete alternative global reproduction lemma is supplied locally, with coefficient bound exp(Cn), n*h bounded and arbitrary finite dense samples. Its proof uses finite Fejer sums, explicit equispaced Lagrange extrapolation, polynomial damping, compactness and finite convex separation. No claim is made to reproduce the external theorem locality/support condition, which is unnecessary for the Gaussian bound.
